query: How do I check my newborn's citizenship status?
reference_answer: A child born in Singapore to legally married parents who are both Singapore citizens (or either one is a Singapore citizen) at the time of child's birth, is automatically a Singapore Citizen.
context:
[Document 1]
If you have submitted your application on or after 26 June 2024, you may log in to the ICA e-Service with your reference number to check the status of your Singapore Citizenship, Permanent Residence or Long-Term Visit Pass application.You will be redirected to the Case Summary page where you can check your status enquiry.

[Document 2]
You can enquire the details of your REP by clicking the "Check Application Status" function in the e-Service.

[Document 3]
ICA does not register birth of a child who is born overseas. You should register the child's birth and obtain the birth certificate from the foreign authorities in the country/place where the child was born.You may refer to ICA website for more information on citizenship application for your child.

[Document 4]
Singapore Permanent Residents (PR) are eligible to apply for Singapore citizenship two years after being granted Singapore PR status.

[Document 5]
You may check the status of your online application or retrieve your application reference number by logging in to MyICA.For hardcopy applications, you may log in to our e-Service.
answer: To check a newborn's citizenship status, first ensure the child has a birth certificate from the foreign country. Then, log in to MyICA or the ICA e-Service with your reference number to check the status of your citizenship application. [Document 1] & [Document 4] provide specific steps.
